description: Paid, non-read-only x402 tool: $5.00 USDC on Base per domain (x402 v2, exact scheme). Starts a fresh external TLS probe and requires an x402-compatible MCP client with a funded Base USDC buyer wallet. Payment happens ONLY after a valid signed payment; agents must NOT auto-retry paid calls without explicit spend authorization. Returns a structured v2 auditor EVIDENCE BUNDLE not available for free: (1) signed_receipt (fresh Ed25519 JWS TLS receipt), (2) cbom (CycloneDX 1.6 Cryptographic Bill of Materials), (3) auditor_pdf (token-protected printable auditor PDF download URL with timestamp, methodology, explicit limits and SHA-256 digest), and (4) integrity.bundle_jws (bundle-level Ed25519 JWS binding the PDF and CBOM). Preview format for free at /api/v1/attestation/sample.pdf. Measurement limits: one vantage, one public IPv4 endpoint, port 443; may not represent an origin behind a CDN. Supporting transport evidence (NIS2/DORA), NOT a legal compliance certification. Basic scan and receipt stay free (scan_tls). Calling without a signed payment returns the x402 PaymentRequired challenge and never charges.
